sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 63

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 63:1
items.html: The posteriors of the filling of AB, found in the four Names AB, SAG, MA, and BON of Nekudim, have not yet received their correction in Atzilut, and are called the 102 Charuvin [carob pods], for they contain 102 letters. The meaning of this is: only the vessels of the faces of Nekudim were corrected in Atzilut — these are Galgalta and Einayim — but the vessels of the posteriors were not yet corrected; these are the AHP found in every single degree that existed in Nekudim. Galgalta, which is Keter, has four degrees, which are: first, the four letters of the face, found in the plain name HaVaYaH; second, the ten letters of the posteriors of the plain HaVaYaH; third, the gematria of the four letters of the face, which is 26; fourth, the gematria of the ten letters of the posteriors, which is 72. All four of these degrees are the phase of Galgalta. Likewise there are four degrees in the phase of Einayim, which is AB and Hochma with respect to the vessels, namely: the ten letters of the face, of HaVaYaH in the filling of AB; the gematria of the ten letters of the face, which is the number 72; the twenty-six letters of the posteriors; and the gematria of the twenty-six letters of the posteriors, which is the number 184. All four of these degrees are of the phase of Einayim. Now, only the four plain degrees found in the phase of Galgalta, and the first degree of the face found in the phase of Einayim, were corrected in Atzilut — that is, only five degrees in all. But the sixth degree, which is the posteriors of the filling of AB, was not corrected even in the phase of AB, let alone the remaining degrees of Ozen, Hotem, and Peh themselves. This is for the reason stated above, that only the phase of the face was corrected, which is Galgalta and Einayim, and nothing of the posteriors was corrected, not even of the posteriors of the phase of Einayim. Hence these degrees, from the sixth degree onward, are called by the name the 102 Charuvin, meaning that the ruin of the breaking of the vessels still rests there, still awaiting their correction.
